title: Patterns in a short text
instructions: Read the whole text, then choose the set of words for all three gaps.

parts.prompt: Hana apologised ___ arriving late. She explained that she had been waiting ___ a bus, and her teacher agreed ___ let her finish the test.

choice_rationales.A: Apologise for is the pattern, wait for is the pattern, and agree to comes before a verb.
choice_rationales.B: Apologise for, wait for and agree to are all the usual patterns.
choice_rationales.C: Apologise does not pair with of, and wait does not pair with to here.
choice_rationales.D: Apologise does not pair with at, and agree does not pair with by.

parts.hint: Check each gap on its own, then read the text again.
parts.correct_explanation: The three patterns are apologise for, wait for and agree to.
